title: Djv-Maintenance (lite)
description: MaintenanceMode is modern solution for managing server maintenance breaks.
body:
Professional Server Lockdown Solution by Dejavu
MaintenanceMode is the ultimate lightweight solution for managing server maintenance on Minecraft 1.21. Whether you are performing a quick bug fix or a massive content update, this plugin ensures your server remains secure and players are informed.

Why Choose Djv-maintenance?
1. Fully Customizable - Every single message sent to the player or displayed in the kick screen can be translated and customized in messages.yml.
2. Role-Based Access - You don't need to be an Operator to join. Simply give your staff the bypass permission, and they can work on the server while it remains closed to the public.

🔧 Commands & Permissions
We believe in simplicity. One command controls everything.

Commands
/maintenance on — Instantly enables maintenance mode, kicks all players without bypass rights, and saves the state to config.
/maintenance off — Disables maintenance mode and allows players to join.
/maintenance reload — Reloads the messages.yml and config.yml without restarting the server.

Permissions
Permission - Default - Description
maintenance.toggle	OP	Allows a player to use the /maintenance command to lock/unlock the server.
maintenance.bypass	OP	Allows a player to join the server even when maintenance is active. Perfect for Admins, Builders, and Developers.

💎 Unlock Premium Features
Do you want to turn your maintenance time into a hype event?
Support Dejavu on Patreon to get the Premium Edition of this plugin!

Premium Features Include:

⏱️ Automatic Timers: Schedule maintenance with /maintenance start (x)h. The server opens automatically when the time is up!
📊 BossBar & Titles: Display a countdown timer or a static "Maintenance Mode" bar at the top of the screen for staff.
🎨 HEX Color Support: Use beautiful gradients and RGB colors (e.g., &#FF0000) in all messages.
📝 Dynamic MOTD: Show the countdown timer directly in the multiplayer server list description!
